content: Hatei Job ni a pathung teh,

content.text: Hnotithainae ka tawn hoeh e teh, bangtelamaw na kabawp,
thaonae ka tawn hoeh e kut teh, bangtelamaw na rungngang thai.
Lungangnae ka tawn hoeh e teh, bangtelamaw na toun thai,
tami moikapap koevah kalan e pouknae hah bangtelamaw na poe thai.
Api koe maw lawk teh na pâpho pouh.
Apie muitha maw nama koe ka phat.
Tami kadout hah a pâyaw teh, tui rahim vah ao teh,
haw vah kaawm e naw hoi a pâyaw awh.
A hmalah duenae caici lah ao.
Rawkphainae ni ramuknae tawn hoeh.
Kalvan teh ahrawnghrang dawk a kangdue.
Talai hai ahrawnghrang dawk a kâbang.
Katha poung e tâmai dawk tui hah mek a racut teh,
a rahim e tâmai hah kâbawng awh hoeh.
A bawitungkhung e hmalah a ramuk teh,
a lathueng vah tâmai a tabo sak.
Angnae hoi hmonae langri a ta nahanelah
tui dawk a langri a ruen pouh.
Kalvan toenae khom a kâhuet teh,
a tounnae hah kângai lah a ru.
A hnotithainae lahoi tuipui a thaw sak.
Bahu lahoi tûilî hah thawk a kapek.
A muitha lahoi kalvan a pathoup sak.
Kamleng e khorui hai a kut hoi a sak.
Khenhaw! hetnaw heh lamthung nueng kamtawngnae doeh.
Ahnimouh koe e thai awh e hrolawk teh, banghloimaw a thoung.
Hateiteh, keitat hnotithainae hah, apinimaw a panue thai.
